N_gesture.question: Extended empty hand or raised open palm; distinguish separate held object.

W_branch.question: Held narrow stem with distinct branching or lobed terminals.

S_long_tool.question: Held long shaft with a widened fibrous-looking bundle at an end, rather than merely a bend.

S_spindle.question: Separate slender shaft with fusiform/whorl-like thickening; say where both ends terminate.

S_thread.question: Fine continuous connection between the two distinct implements/hands, rather than independent closed bead-like outlines.

S_links.question: Hanging series of individually outlined rounded links or beads.

E_frame.question: Held framework with a main rod and separated cross-ended/transverse terminals, not only one bulb/neck outline.

E_winding.question: Lines wound on or linking that frame and a separate implement/hand.

E_vessel.question: Single enclosed rounded bulb narrowing into a neck with a distinct rim/opening-like top.

center.question: Describe central object and how figure bodies meet the shared boundary; descriptive only.
